name: immich
title: Immich
description: Search your Immich photo library by what is in the picture and browse the results as a grid. Albums, people and today's memories are one keystroke away, and a photo opens, copies or downloads from the list.
author: pal

settings.label: URL
settings.description: Where the Immich API answers, scheme included; no trailing slash needed.

settings.label: API key
settings.description: From Immich › Account Settings › API Keys. Reading needs asset.read, album.read, person.read, memory.read and asset.download; favouriting asset.update and adding to albums albumAsset.create. Stored as a keychain: or env: reference.

settings.label: Web address
settings.description: Where Open in Immich and Copy link point when the site has another name than the API (a tailnet API behind a public site). Empty: the URL above.

settings.label: Download to
settings.description: Where Download preview and Download original write, named `<date>_<file>`.

store.tagline: Search your Immich photos by what is in them
features: Search by what is in the photo ("a receipt", "dog on the beach"), or by file name
Narrow by date and place with `since:2025`, `in:2023` or `in:Ataşehir`; filter to videos or favourites
A side pane with the photo large, when and where it was taken, the camera, the people and the albums
`enter` opens it in Immich; copy the link or the picture, download it, favourite it or add it to an album
Albums, people and On this day as lists of their own
Thumbnails are cached, so a second look is instant

screenshots.caption: Nothing typed: the newest uploads, the pane open on the first
A CLIP search: what is in the picture, the place and date on every tile
What a photo can do: open, copy, download, favourite, add to an album, Quick Look
Albums: the cover, the count, the dates, the library's numbers on top
On this day: a row per year, Enter opens that year's photos

actions.title: Open in Immich
actions.description: The photo's page on the web address.

actions.title: Copy image
actions.description: The preview onto the clipboard as a picture.

actions.title: Download original
actions.description: The file as uploaded (a HEIC, an ARW, a video).

actions.title: Add to album…
actions.description: A picker of your albums, or a new one.

immich.title: Immich
immich.description: Type what is in the picture and Immich's CLIP search answers as a grid; a file name searches by name; nothing typed lists the newest uploads. since:, before:, in: narrow it; the dropdown picks photos, videos, favourites or the archive.

settings.label: Columns
settings.description: Tiles per row in every grid.

albums.title: Immich Albums
albums.description: Every album with its cover, count and dates; Enter opens the album as a grid, cmd+enter opens it in Immich. The library's numbers lead the list.

people.title: Immich People
people.description: The people Immich has named, favourites first, each with their face; Enter lists a person's photos as a grid.

memories.title: On This Day
memories.description: Immich's memories for today: a row per past year with the count and the places; Enter opens that year's photos as a grid.

search.description: Open the Immich grid on a search

q.description: What to search for; empty lists the newest uploads. since:, before: and in: work here too

album.description: Open an album as a grid

name.description: The album's name (case does not matter)

name.description: The person's name as Immich has it (case does not matter)
